answer.explanation: Customer is a domain entity, but it imports the `typeorm` package and uses the `@Entity()` decorator. That ties the domain model to a persistence framework. FF-DT04 flags this because the domain layer must not depend on infrastructure packages. The exceptions table (docs/architecture-exceptions.md:7) lists this exact file and rule, but its status is "Expired 2026-08-31, not renewed". Today is 2026-10-22, so the exception no longer applies. The same line says the decorator must now be removed from the domain, which declares the rule the code breaks. The code comment at line 1 only says the mapping will move to infrastructure. That is an intention, not a grant.
